battle.name: 秘魯獨立戰爭
battle.theater: 安第斯山區與秘魯海岸線
battle.brief: 1809年安第斯山區響應西班牙的自治運動，1811至1814年間接連起義；聖馬丁率解放遠征軍登陸秘魯海岸，1821年7月15日簽署獨立宣言，1824年亞克丘一役擊潰王室陸軍，1826年卡亞俄要塞投降。卡面板甲胸甲是十六世紀西班牙步兵的舊式防具，一八二〇年代僅總督警衛穿著。

kit.name: 板甲胸甲
kit.history: 鍛鐵的胸甲讓步槍變成冷兵器。馬爾康·波佐多的改變比任何一場戰役都快。

countries: 交戰雙方是西班牙王國的王室派與南美愛國派。王室一方的核心是秘魯總督府：1814年由總督何塞·德·阿瓦斯卡爾侯爵整編出「秘魯王室陸軍」，以利馬與阿雷基帕的市防營、歐洲派來的「王室志願兵」營以及正規線列步兵為骨幹，其後分編為利馬的王室軍、庫斯科的王室軍與上秘魯的安第斯王室軍，先後由總督何塞·德拉·塞爾納侯爵與將軍何塞·德·坎特拉克等人統率，另有總督近衛軍與卡亞俄「費利佩王要塞」的守軍。愛國派一方最初只是城鎮自治議會與地方武裝，1820年後組成跨國的「秘魯解放遠征軍」，陸軍由阿根廷的何塞·德·聖馬丁統率，共四千一百一十八人，艦隊由英國海軍上將托馬斯·亞歷山大·科克倫率領；1823年國會向玻利瓦爾求援後，大哥倫比亞的北方遠征軍入境，由西蒙·玻利瓦爾與安東尼奧·何塞·蘇克雷分率大軍與前鋒。此外還有安第斯山區的愛國派游擊隊、秘魯北部的保王民兵，以及以山區農民為主力的鄉土長矛騎兵「突擊隊」分別投入各條戰線。
countriesEn: The two sides were the royalist camp of the Spanish monarchy and the patriots of Spanish South America. The core of the royalist side was the Viceroyalty of Peru: in 1814 Viceroy Jose Fernando de Abascal y Sousa reorganised the field forces into the Real Ejército del Peru, built on the urban battalions of Lima and Arequipa, the European expatriate volunteer battalions and the regular line infantry. It later split into the royal army of Lima, the Royal Army of Cuzco and the Royal Army of the Andes in Upper Peru, commanded in turn by Viceroy Jose de la Serna and General Jose de Canterac, alongside the viceregal guard and the garrison of the Real Felipe fortress at Callao. The patriot side began as nothing more than town councils and local armed bands; in 1820 it became a trans-national Liberating Expedition of Peru whose 4,118 men were led by the Argentine general Jose de San Martin, while the fleet was entrusted to the British admiral Thomas Alexander Cochrane. After the Peruvian congress appealed for help in 1823, the Gran Colombian Northern Expedition entered the country under Simon Bolivar, with Antonio Jose de Sucre commanding the vanguard. Mountain guerrillas, royalist militias of northern Peru and lance-armed montoneras raised from Andean peasants were committed on every front.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨兩代政治格局。何塞·德·阿瓦斯卡爾侯爵在1808至1814年間主持秘魯防務，組織上秘魯的王室軍並把富銀的上秘魯併入總督區，令利馬商人得利而南部礦區受損，是王室派得以長期固守的關鍵人物；1814至1815年的庫斯科起義則由退役旅長、印加裔首長馬特奧·普馬卡瓦亞率領，他早年曾協助平定1780年代的圖帕克·阿馬魯二世起義，晚年卻改變立場加入自治運動，於1815年被處決。1820年之後，何塞·德·聖馬丁以果斷的海岸登陸與長距離山區機動主導戰局，他在1822年離開秘魯，把戰爭交給玻利瓦爾；科克倫指揮的解放艦隊在1820年11月9日的卡亞俄海戰中損失護衛艦「埃斯梅拉達」，但仍封鎖了王室派的海上補給。玻利瓦爾在瓜亞基爾會議上與聖馬丁爭執國家體制，隨後於1824年率軍翻越安第斯山，6月於帕斯科擊敗坎特拉克；其麾下蘇克雷則在亞克丘以極高明的部署擊潰安第斯王室軍。智利的奧伊金斯、玻利瓦爾的參謀部與大哥倫比亞的龍騎兵指揮官，也都在這場戰爭中扮演了關鍵角色。
peopleEn: Key figures span two generations of politics. Jose Fernando de Abascal y Sousa directed Peru's defence between 1808 and 1814, raised the royal armies of Upper Peru and annexed the silver-rich upper region to the viceroyalty, which benefited the Lima merchants at the expense of the southern mining districts and was the reason the royalist cause could hold on so long. The Cuzco rising of 1814 to 1815 was led by the retired brigadier and indigenous curaca Mateo Pumacahua, who had helped suppress Tupac Amaru II in the 1780s and later reversed his own position; he was executed in 1815. From 1820 Jose de San Martin drove the war with a bold coastal landing and long marches into the highlands, and in 1822 he left Peru, handing the fight over to Bolivar. Cochrane's liberating squadron lost the frigate Esmeralda to the batteries of Callao on 9 November 1820, yet still blockaded the royalist sea communications. Bolivar, who had already quarrelled with San Martin at the Guayaquil Conference over the form of government, crossed the Andes in 1824 and defeated Canterac at Pasco in June; in December Sucre used the ground at Ayacucho to destroy the Royal Army of the Andes. Leaders such as O'Higgins of Chile, Bolivar's staff and the commanders of the Gran Colombian lancers all shaped the outcome of the campaign.
kits: 卡面這件板甲胸甲（coraza，1530年）是十六世紀西班牙線列步兵的半身護具，鍛鐵鍍黑並帶護肩，用來抵擋火繩槍的破甲彈與冷兵器直刺。它是征服時代的技術高水位，到1809至1826年的秘魯戰爭裡卻只剩象徵性的殘留：王室陸軍的線列步兵、總督近衛與卡亞俄要塞守軍仍零星配發鐵製胸甲，多數士官與軍官才有，其餘部隊多以皮甲或棉背心應付；愛國派方面幾乎全無金屬護甲，解放遠征軍與山區游擊隊穿粗布衣、戴寬邊草帽或巴拿馬帽，靠皮帶與彈盒作戰。最能反映技術轉型的，是玻利瓦爾麾下「胡寧輕騎兵」採用的一整張牛皮圍裙配頭盔與護腿，那是胸甲在十九世紀最廉價而實用的替代品。除此之外，戰場主力裝備是滑膛燧發火槍配刺刀，雙方近戰最後仍靠刺刀解決；騎兵用馬刀與長矛；山區有大量獵槍、投石索與散彈獵槍。砲兵方面，秘魯靠銀礦歲入供養重量級火炮，卡亞俄要塞架有數十門大炮與數門巨型臼炮，1820年11月即以岸炮擊沉科克倫的護衛艦；攻方則靠海軍封鎖、壕溝、坑道與爆破，最終在1824年12月9日亞克丘之役與1826年1月卡亞俄投降後才結束正面戰鬥。
kitsEn: The cuirass on the card is the coraza of 1530, the half-armour of sixteenth-century Spanish line infantry: forged iron, blackened, with shoulder guards, meant to turn musket balls and edged weapons. It was the technological high-water mark of the conquest era, and by 1809 to 1826 it survived in Peru only as a remnant. The Royal Army of Peru's line infantry, the viceregal guard and the Callao garrison still received iron breastplates, though in practice only sergeants and officers commonly had them, and the rest made do with hide and padded jackets. The patriots had almost no metal protection at all: the liberating expedition and the mountain bands fought in coarse cloth, wearing broad-brimmed straw hats and Panama hats, and relied on cartridge boxes and belts. The clearest sign of the technical transition is the full leather apron worn by Bolivar's Junin Hussars, together with helmet and greaves, the cheapest and most practical nineteenth-century successor to the breastplate. Everything else on the field was smoothbore flintlock musket and bayonet, and close fighting was still decided at the point of the bayonet; cavalry used sabres and lances; the highlands supplied shotguns, slings and hunting guns. The artillery was the silver-funded heavy battery: Callao mounted several dozen cannon and a few large mortars, and in November 1820 its shore guns sank Cochrane's frigate. The besiegers answered with blockade, trench, sap and mine, and the frontal struggle only ended after Ayacucho in December 1824 and the surrender of Callao in January 1826.
tactics: 秘魯的地理決定了兩套完全不同的打法。愛國派初期佔優，靠的是山區游擊：武裝農夫與鄉土長矛騎兵在沒有道路的安第斯谷地與峽谷之間作戰，利用熟悉小徑的優勢分割敵軍，燒毀屯糧與礦區設施，迫使王室分兵防守。聖馬丁的戰略是揚長避短，他不強攻沿海岸的卡亞俄與阿里卡兩座要塞，改由海路自瓦爾帕萊索出發，在皮斯科登陸後直插內陸高原，在塞羅德帕斯科擊敗王室分遣隊，逼總督放棄利馬。玻利瓦爾接手後轉為沿山區皇家大道正面推進：縱隊行軍、以騎兵遮蔽側翼、逐點攻下高原要地，1824年先在帕斯科取勝，再於8月6日的胡寧以密集騎兵衝擊破壞敵軍步兵陣。12月9日亞克丘一役，蘇克雷把主力放在亞克丘城郊的高地與梯田上，居高臨下控制通往山下的唯一通道，逼坎特拉克的王室軍在狹窄地帶展開，再以近距離霰彈火炮與突擊部隊封住缺口；關鍵時刻又把牛群羊群驅入克恩達洪達峽谷以截斷敵軍騎兵衝鋒，哥倫比亞龍騎兵與胡寧輕騎兵隨即反擊得手，攻守就此逆轉。
tacticsEn: Peruvian geography dictated two entirely different ways of fighting. The patriots' early strength lay in mountain irregular warfare: armed peasants and montonera lancers fought between the ravines and dry valleys of the Andes, using their knowledge of the paths to divide the enemy, burn stores and mining installations, and force the crown to spread its troops thin. San Martin's strategy was to avoid the enemy's strengths. He left the coastal fortresses of Callao and Arica alone, sailed from Valparaiso, landed at Pisco and pushed straight into the interior highlands, beat a royalist detachment at Cerro de Pasco, and forced the viceroy to abandon Lima. Bolivar then advanced along the royal road through the sierra: marching in column, screening the flanks with cavalry and taking the plateau strongholds one by one, with a victory at Pasco in 1824 and then, on 6 August, at Junin, where massed cavalry broke the Spanish infantry. At Ayacucho on 9 December, Sucre placed his main body on the heights and terraces above the town, commanding the only road down to the valley and forcing Canterac's Royal Army of the Andes to deploy in a narrow sector. He answered the Spanish counter-attack down the slope with canister at close range, and at the critical moment drove cattle and sheep into the Quebrada Honda ravine to break the Spanish cavalry charge, whereupon the Gran Colombian lancers and the Junin Hussars counter-attacked and carried the field.
data: 可考的數字集中在幾個節點上。解放遠征軍共四千一百一十八人，1820年8月21日自瓦爾帕萊索舉帆，9月7日抵達皮斯科海灣，8日即控制全區，是全戰役規模最大的一次跨國陸軍投送。戰爭自1809年的自治運動起，到1826年1月卡亞俄與奇洛埃的最後堡壘投降，歷時約十七年；其中1814至1820年間秘魯基本是王室派的地盤，決定性的會戰集中在最後四年。1821年7月15日簽署獨立宣言，7月28日對外宣告獨立；1824年8月6日胡寧之戰與12月9日亞克丘之戰，是王室野戰部隊被消滅的兩個轉折點；1826年1月卡亞俄與奇洛埃守軍投降，1827年2月16日大哥倫比亞駐軍把費利佩王要塞交還秘魯，秘魯才取得完全主權。亞克丘一役雙方投入都在數千人量級，具體數字諸說並存：一般認為蘇克雷一方主力約二千五百至三千人，王室軍約三千至四千人；王室軍損失慘重，傷亡與被俘合計近千人，哥倫比亞方面的損失則被描述為數百人。其他可考或大致可靠的數字有：利馬在1820年前後人口約六萬；卡亞俄要塞架有數十門火炮；胡寧輕騎兵與哥倫比亞龍騎兵的團隊規模多在數百騎。此外，秘魯在1822年向倫敦發行的國債、以及上秘魯銀礦在1825年被劃歸玻利維亞後王室財政的崩潰，都是相對明確的史實。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster around a few landmarks. The Liberating Expedition numbered 4,118 men; it raised anchor at Valparaiso on 21 August 1820, reached the bay of Pisco on 7 September and controlled the whole province by the 8th, which makes it the largest combined land and sea insertion of the war. The conflict ran from the juntas of 1809 to the surrender of the last strongholds at Callao and Chiloe in January 1826, about seventeen years, though Peru was in practice royalist between 1814 and 1820 and the decisive operations occupy only the last four. The Act of Independence was signed on 15 July 1821 and independence proclaimed on 28 July; Junin on 6 August 1824 and Ayacucho on 9 December 1824 destroyed the royalist field armies; Callao and the Chiloe forts surrendered in January 1826, and on 16 February 1827 the Gran Colombian garrison handed the Real Felipe fortress back to Peru, the moment Peru obtained complete sovereignty. At Ayacucho both sides committed forces in the low thousands and the exact numbers are disputed: the usual account gives Sucre some two thousand five hundred to three thousand men against roughly three to four thousand for the royalists, with the royalists losing close to a thousand men killed or captured and the Colombian side suffering a few hundred. Other firm or reasonably secure figures: Lima had around sixty thousand inhabitants around 1820; Callao mounted several dozen guns; the Junin Hussars and the Gran Colombian lancers were raised in squadrons of several hundred riders each. Also solid are the Peruvian loan floated in London in 1822 and the collapse of the royal treasury once the silver mines of Upper Peru were assigned to Bolivia in 1825.
cause: 戰爭的起因，是西班牙帝國與安第斯山之間一連串危機的交會。十八世紀波旁改革把安第斯原住民推向爆發點，1780至1781年圖帕克·阿馬魯二世的起義雖被鎮壓，生絲與礦區的配額、混血階層與原住民之間的差別待遇卻並未消失。真正的引爆點出現在1808年：拿破崙入侵西班牙，卡洛斯四世與斐迪南七世退位讓位給約瑟夫·波拿巴，母國出現權力真空，殖民地自治議會紛紛成立；1810至1814年加的斯制憲會議頒布的自由主義改革在秘魯屍遭拖延與反對，克里奧爾知識分子與土生商賈既不滿本土派壟斷貿易，又懼怕改革帶來的廢奴與族群升級，一八〇九年春庫斯科與奧塔一帶出現的自治議會便由此而來。可是阿瓦斯卡爾把富銀的上秘魯併入總督區，令利馬商人得利、南部礦區受損，經濟失衡反而把南部推向武裝起義。1811年塔克納的弗朗西斯科·安東尼奧·德·塞拉與1812年萬諾科起義接連失敗，卻證明只要跨過族群界線，起義就能成事，於是威廉莫爾派系與聖馬丁的遠征軍才得以在1820年把自治運動升級為全國性戰爭。
causeEn: The war grew out of a collision between crises in the Spanish empire and in the Andes. Bourbon reforms in the eighteenth century pushed the indigenous population of the Andes towards open revolt: the rising of Tupac Amaru II in 1780 to 1781 was crushed, but the quotas imposed on the textile districts and mines, and the legal inferiority of the indigenous majority, survived. The real detonator came in 1808, when Napoleon's invasion of Spain forced Charles IV and Ferdinand VII to abdicate in favour of Joseph Bonaparte. A vacuum in the mother country produced a wave of autonomous juntas in the colonies, and the liberal reforms of the Cadiz Cortes of 1810 to 1814 were repeatedly delayed and resisted in Peru. Creole intellectuals and merchants resented the peninsula's commercial monopoly while fearing the social consequences of reform, and in the spring of 1809 juntas appeared at Cuzco and Oruro. Yet when Abascal annexed the silver-rich Upper Peru to the viceroyalty, the Lima merchants gained and the southern mining districts lost, and that economic imbalance pushed the south into armed revolt instead. The rising at Tacna led by Francisco Antonio de Zela in 1811 and the Huánuco rising of 1812 both failed, but each showed that a rising could cross the ethnic divide, and that proof is what allowed the Whitelists and San Martin's expedition to turn a local autonomy movement into a national war in 1820.
impact: 戰爭的結果遠不只換了一面國旗。秘魯王國於1821年成立，聖馬丁一度以「保護者」身分治理，起義期間與加的斯制憲會議都許諾的廢奴，在秘魯的立法中一波三折，直到一八二〇年代中期才逐步落實，而山區莊園裡的原住民「佩昂」役與地役束縛更延續到一八五四年卡斯特蒂利亞的改革為止，西班牙式大莊園與礦場徵役的結構幾乎原封不動地被獨立後的國家承襲下來。西班牙在南美最富的銀礦區上秘魯在1825年被玻利瓦爾分離出去，成為獨立的玻利維亞，王室派失去主要財源，戰敗已無可挽回；大哥倫比亞軍隊隨後佔領秘魯北部，一八二六年的安第斯共和國邦聯計劃，以及玻利瓦爾與聖馬丁在瓜亞基爾會議上君主制與共和制之爭，都把秘魯捲入拉丁美洲建國最激烈的一段試驗。獨立後的秘魯幾乎立即陷入內戰：一八二四至一八二五年的「三總統之年」，卡斯特蒂利亞以廢除地役為名起兵反對出售國有土地，一八二六年的南部駐軍叛亂，玻利瓦爾一八二五年的十二月法令與南方的分離運動，隨後還有聖克魯斯的玻利維亞一度南下攻入秘魯，於因加維與永加伊兩役被秘魯擊敗。國防軍隊的重建、軍閥政治與礦區所有制的重組，都以這場戰爭為起點。
impactEn: The war did more than change a flag. The Kingdom of Peru was founded in 1821 and San Martin governed for a time as Protector, but the abolition of slavery promised by the insurgents and by the Cadiz Cortes was implemented in fits and starts, appearing in Peruvian law only in the mid-1820s, and the indenture of the Andean peasant, the peonaje, together with the tied land system, lasted until Ramon Castilla's reform of 1854; the Spanish hacienda and the mining levy passed into the new republic almost unchanged. The richest silver region of all Spanish America, Upper Peru, was separated out as an independent Bolivia in 1825, and with it went the royalist treasury that had been funding the war, making the royalist defeat irreversible. The Gran Colombian army then occupied northern Peru, and the Andean Republic project of 1826, together with the constitutional-versus-republic quarrel between Bolivar and San Martin at Guayaquil, drew Peru into the most violent experiment in Latin American nation-building. Almost at once the new republic fell into civil war: the Year of the Three Presidents in 1824 to 1825, Castilla's revolt of 1825 against the sale of public lands and in favour of ending the land service, the mutiny of the southern garrison in 1826, Bolivar's December decree of 1825 and the separatist movement in the south, followed by Santa Cruz's Bolivian incursion into Peru, which was defeated at Ingavi and Yungay. The remaking of the army, the politics of the caudillos and the ownership of the mines all begin with this war.
result: 1824年12月9日的亞克丘是西班牙在南美最後一場決定性野戰：蘇克雷的聯軍在高地正面擊潰安第斯王室軍，坎特拉克負傷被俘，王室軍主官相繼淪為俘虜，約近千名官兵傷亡或被俘，殘部沿安第斯山北麓北撤，隨後在拉巴斯附近的因加維一役再遭重創。1825年4月蘇克雷在上秘魯的行程結束，富銀的上秘魯易主，新生的玻利維亞由此取得自己的國庫。1826年1月，拉蒙·羅迪爾率守軍退守卡亞俄費利佩王要塞的最後一批王室派向玻利瓦爾投降，奇洛埃一帶的堡壘也一併放下武器；1827年2月16日，大哥倫比亞駐軍把要塞交還秘魯，秘魯從此不再受任何外來佔領軍庇護，首都仍設在利馬，國土以安第斯山脈為骨架，北界劃在哥倫比亞與玻利維亞一線。獨立確實成功了，但它換來的是一個財政枯竭、軍隊解體、土地問題懸而未決、南北分裂傾向嚴重的新國家；隨後十餘年的內戰與外戰，幾乎都由這場戰爭遺留下來的軍隊、邊界與土地爭端一路延伸下去。
resultEn: Ayacucho on 9 December 1824 was the last decisive field battle Spain fought in South America. Sucre's army broke the Royal Army of the Andes on the heights; Canterac was wounded and taken prisoner, the senior royalist commanders fell into captivity, close to a thousand men were killed or captured, and the broken remnants withdrew north along the Andes, where they were badly mauled again at Ingavi near La Paz. Sucre's campaign in Upper Peru ended in April 1825, and the silver mines passed to the new state of Bolivia with its own treasury. In January 1826 the last royalists at Callao, under Ramon Rodil, capitulated from the Real Felipe fortress, and the works around Chiloe were likewise dismantled. On 16 February 1827 the Gran Colombian garrison handed the fortress back to Peru; Peru was now under no foreign occupation, kept its capital at Lima, and was bounded by the Andes with its northern frontier drawn against Colombia and Bolivia. Independence was indeed won, but what it produced was a new state with an exhausted treasury, a disbanded army, an unresolved land question and a strong centrifugal pull between north and south. The civil wars and foreign wars of the following decade grew directly out of the armies, frontiers and land disputes this conflict left behind.
